chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said to one of his companions:

Do not make the majority of your preoccupation with your family and children: for if your family and children are the friends of Allah, then Allah will not neglect His friends; and if they are the enemies of Allah, then what is your concern and preoccupation with the enemies of Allah?
ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim balance family duties with spiritual priorities according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises his companions to balance their worldly duties with spiritual priorities by not over-focusing on their families. He argues that if the family are righteous (friends of God), God will care for them, and if they are righteous, they will be cared for by God; if they are enemies of God, excessive worry is unnecessary.
